rubric.evidence: models/stanford-deidentifier-base/worker.js runs the REAL token-classification pipeline (onnx-community/stanford-deidentifier-base-ONNX, WASM q8, 105MB) with aggregation_strategy "none" — per-token PHI labels over the flat 7-class scheme (PATIENT/HCW/HOSPITAL/DATE/ID/PHONE/VENDOR + O), merged into spans with a punctuation-bridging flat-run merge. Validator (scripts/validate-stanford-deidentifier-base.mjs) proved real output on all 4 routes × desktop+mobile: overview found Maria Gonzalez + ≥5 spans across ≥4 categories with 7-count legend; basics highlighted the PATIENT span; practical redacted Maria Gonzalez + 567-493-1234 into [REDACTED]/[DATE]/[PATIENT]; wild replaced them with synthetic surrogates (St. Mary's General, 02/14/2023…). 28/28 checks passed, exit 0.

classify returns {text, tokens (per-token entity/score/word with char offsets), spans (merged, with pooled score + tokenCount), counts (per category), ms, device}. Semantic sanity: PubMedBERT-uncased lowercasing handled via case-insensitive offset mapping; "1/1/2020" and "567-493-1234" stay single spans via bridge rule (validated: practical output redacted the phone as one unit).

At-a-glance declares exact loadable id onnx-community/stanford-deidentifier-base-ONNX (linked) + original StanfordAIMI/stanford-deidentifier-base (linked), task token-classification, architecture PubMedBERT-base, dtype q8, backend WASM, size ~105MB, license MIT (both repos), web APIs. model-loader entry matches (modelId literal at loader call site — portfolio-acceptance stage extraction passes).

Index: 4-mode segmented control (highlight/redact/tag/replace) with aria-pressed, 3 sample chips, De-identify button, legend, per-category counts, see-inside token chain (per-token label + confidence, low-confidence flagged). Practical: [REDACTED]/[CATEGORY] toggle re-renders immediately + Copy (navigator.clipboard with execCommand fallback + aria-live "Copied"). Wild: Replace + New surrogates (seed reshuffle) + Copy. Basics: 8 one-category sample chips. All keyboard-accessible; validator drove the real controls (mode toggle, reshuffle).

No canned output anywhere: every span/highlight/redaction/surrogate derives from the live pipeline result in the worker. Validator asserted the actual PHI text (Maria Gonzalez, 567-493-1234) is present in highlight mode and ABSENT after redaction/replacement.

Labels bound to textarea; segmented buttons use aria-pressed; status + copy feedback via role=status/aria-live=polite; legend chips are text (not color-only — category names shown); highlight uses CSS Custom Highlight API over a live text node with a <mark> fallback, never innerHTML with user text; doc output tabindex=0 for keyboard reading. Automated hygiene in validator: all buttons named, overflow 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800. Full SR focus-order pass is a follow-up goal.

Route-complete validator ran every route at DESKTOP (1280×800) and MOBILE (360×740 DPR3): overflow ≤ 0-1px on all 8 cells, controls named, console + network clean. responsive-check pre-scan: desktop clean · mobile clean. support recorded as needs-review (automated signal only).

Inference entirely off the main thread (module worker, worker-protocol-style handshake); page renders via DOM assembly, no per-frame loops; token chain capped to flagged tokens. q8 105MB single-file ONNX keeps load light vs fp32 (415MB). Long-task/INP measurement is a follow-up goal (validator measured ~2-10s inference on WASM CPU).

guidanceConsulted.query: highlight named entities inline in text with color-coded spans and a legend
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use the CSS Custom Highlight API: collect text nodes with TreeWalker, create Range objects on text nodes, CSS.highlights.clear() before re-registering, group same-style ranges into one Highlight with priority.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied in deident.js renderHighlight: live text node + Range per span, per-category Highlight registered under phi-<category>, CSS.highlights.clear() before each render; <mark class="phi"> fallback via DOM construction (never innerHTML with user text).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible control panel for a redact toggle + copy button
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic controls, visible labels, non-color state cues, aria-pressed for exclusive toggles, and link help/status text via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: labelled textarea, segmented buttons with aria-pressed, text labels on legend chips (not color-only), copy feedback through role=status aria-live=polite plus button label change.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel with textarea and segmented buttons no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Modern intrinsic layout (flex/grid wrap), no fixed widths, container-safe controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: controls/legend/counts use flex-wrap + grid auto-fit with design-system tokens; verified 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800 across all routes in the validator.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel with textarea and segmented buttons no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Control clipping at element boundaries with overflow: clip where needed rather than global hacks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied as a check: validator asserts documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth <= 1 on every route cell; token-chain wraps with reduced font size under 560px.

openQuestions: The base model collapses PHI to 7 categories (no separate LOCATION): city/state mentions may be tagged O or HOSPITAL depending on context — worth documenting an honest 'what the model doesn't do' note beyond the existing caveat.
Surrogate replacement is per-span pool-picked; a production 'hide in plain sight' tool would want gender/date-format-consistent surrogates (e.g. match 1/1/2020 vs January 1, 2020 formats).
followUpGoals: Add a multi-model rung composing de-identification → translation (M2M100) or → summarization (DistilBART): de-identify a note, then summarize/translate the safe version for a non-English-speaking patient.
Full screen-reader + keyboard focus-order matrix pass across all 4 routes (agent-driven, flipping support ok).
Measure long-tasks/INP on mobile with the model downloaded (first-run) and cached (auto-init) to confirm the off-main-thread claim.
Document the model's blind spots (locations folded into O/HOSPITAL, radiology-register bias) as an explicit limits panel.
